title: Velkommen til Lakskongen
description: Your journey as a Norwegian salmon farmer begins. You have 10 million NOK to build your empire.
hint: Take a look at your dashboard to see your starting capital and available zones.

title: Build Your Hatchery
description: Every salmon starts as an egg. Build a hatchery to raise smolts for your sea farms.
hint: Click on the Hatchery tab to purchase your first batch of smolts.

title: Stock Your Pens
description: Your smolts are ready! Transfer them to a sea site to begin the grow-out phase.
hint: Select a sea site and click 'Stock Smolts' to transfer fish from the hatchery.

title: Feed Your Fish
description: Salmon need quality feed to grow. Monitor your Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) — below 1.15 is excellent.
hint: Check the Feed panel to see daily consumption and FCR. Adjust feeding rates if needed.

title: Health Check
description: Monitor your fish for sea lice and disease. Prevention is cheaper than treatment.
hint: Open the Health panel. Keep sea lice below 0.5 per fish to avoid regulatory action.

title: Delousing Operations
description: Sea lice are the #1 challenge in Norwegian salmon farming. Choose your delousing method wisely.
hint: Mechanical delousing costs more but earns sustainability points. Chemical is cheaper but harms your score.

title: Wait for Growth
description: Salmon take 14-18 months to reach harvest weight (4-6 kg). Use this time to plan ahead.
hint: Advance time using the speed controls. Watch your fish grow on the dashboard.

title: First Harvest
description: Your salmon have reached market size! Time to harvest and sell.
hint: Select your sea site and click 'Harvest'. Fish above 4 kg fetch the best prices.

title: Sell to Market
description: The salmon spot price fluctuates daily. Timing your sales matters — or lock in contract prices for stability.
hint: Check the Market panel for current prices. Consider signing a contract for predictable revenue.

title: Research & Innovation
description: Invest in R&D to improve your operations. Better genetics, feed, and technology give you an edge.
hint: Open the Research panel and start your first project. 'Selective Breeding' is a good first choice.

title: Sustainability Matters
description: Norway's traffic light system controls your growth. High sustainability scores unlock premium markets.
hint: Check your Sustainability panel. ASC certification (score 70+) gives an 8% price premium.

title: Expand Your Empire
description: Ready for growth? Build a new sea site in another zone to diversify risk and increase production.
hint: Go to the Map and select a new zone. Build a sea site to start your second farm.
